# RRD Press

> RRD Press (RRDPRESS LLC, United States) is an AI narrative control and PR/SEO agency. It helps brands control how AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and search engines describe, categorize, and surface them, using research-driven narrative engineering, editorial-style press writing, and distribution across 300+ trusted media outlets.

RRD Press combines brand/competitor research, AI prompt testing, high-trust editorial press placements, and search/AI indexing optimization into a single system aimed at making brands "AI-visible" â€” i.e., recommended and cited by AI answer engines, not just ranked in traditional search.
